purpose: Street-furniture modules of Project Y2K's procedural street kit v004 (Blender script), re-derived as Almond library geometry. Library derivation (tools/prepare_organic_meshes.py, procedural route): Blender FBX import at the authored metre size, engine collision hulls (UCX_*) removed, recorded edits applied, kit material slots removed, weld/degenerate cleanup, triangulation, normals recalculated, hard edges kept; no decimation (the target is the source triangle count) and no subdivision. tools/build_generated_assets.py then scales the GLB to millimetres (height = the authored height) and puts the bottom centre on the origin.

origin.project: Project Y2K, the owner's game project (private repository)
records: twofronts/infrastructure/world/street_v004/kit.json (kit record with each module's triangle count, size and FBX SHA-256; retained)

excluded.SM_Drain: Owner-chosen exclusion: drain grate, low fit for the library
excluded.NeonGateway_StreetKit.blend: Source scene of the same modules; the FBX exports are the hashed sources
excluded.city_v009 copies (SM_Bench, SM_StreetLam: Re-exports of these modules; the v004 originals are used
excluded.world/neon_signs_v021 (ten Chinese neon: Lettering tessellated from Windows system fonts (font licences)
excluded.combat_v016/pickups: Game items (the ammo cell is weapon-adjacent)

authoring.basis: No retained Claude Code transcript (Project Y2K or Ginkgo projects) writes or edits this file. The earliest retained Project Y2K transcript starts on 2026-09-12; the script (last modified 2026-09-11T21:42:55+00:00) and its FBX outputs are older. The script refuses to run once the kit .blend exists, and the kit record lists one run. Who wrote the script (a Claude session, the owner or another tool) is therefore not established.

external_reference_status: No external reference recorded: neither the script nor its kit record names one, and the kit record states "Original procedural exterior street kit; no interiors or third-party geometry". No authoring session was found, so no session record could confirm or rule out references.
dimension_basis: Authored kit sizes: the script builds each module in metres and the kit record lists its dimensions; the library keeps them (height = authored height, width and depth measured). Not a physical survey.
rights: Procedural geometry built by a Blender script in the owner's Project Y2K game repository (private); see each script's authoring record for the Claude Code session that wrote it, or that none was found. The owner's own project geometry: no generation provider, account or credits are involved, and the scripts build every piece from Blender primitives (no imported or third-party geometry in these pieces). Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)") and chose the procedural kit pieces on 2026-11-20. Kit material colours and textures are not distributed; Almond materials are assigned.

assets.variant: Rounded slab seat on two block supports, 2.4 m
assets.reference_review: Reviewed on 2026-11-20: procedural geometry, so there is no input image. The prepared library mesh was rendered untextured from the front three-quarter view (500 px, viewed in a 300 px contact sheet) and the script code that models it was read: no lettering, logos, brand marks or characters in the geometry.

assets.variant: 5 m lamp with an arched arm and a blank wayfinding panel

edits.removes: the two-digit number "01" on the wayfinding panel
edits.reason: Tessellated lettering (Blender text objects converted to mesh and joined into the piece by the script's label() helper, 6 mm thick) removed as loose parts no thicker than 6.5 mm along Y; it is cleanly separable from the bevelled boxes, the thinnest of which is 80 mm. Lettering is not shipped.
